source: Ghidra stock program: FUN_00487f20 registers buildNumber at 0048812a; headless DecompileStockHandler.java confirms the loaded executable MD5 and decompiles FUN_0047c0b0 as return 0x25e. Raw handler bytes are b8 5e 02 00 00 c3. See docs/native-lookup.md.

Headless Ghidra decompile and listing of 00481e30; format at 00613398 is %d (read_memory); formatter 00553d70 and 00554170 read in full; result interned by 004174a0. Re-read independently: handler passes the parsed int to FUN_00551220 with format %d, then interns the buffer; 00553d70 cases 0x64/0x69 call 00554170 with the raw int, which negates in 32 bits so INT_MIN yields negative digits; 0041eb70 looks the string up by content hash and compare.

Headless Ghidra listing of 00481f50; copy 00551120 = 005548c0 (at most n-1 bytes, always terminated); backspace on 8, ignore below 0x20, store low byte otherwise; result interned by 004174a0. Re-read independently: 005548c0 copies at most count-1 bytes and always terminates, so a 256 count keeps 255; backspace removes the last byte when length > 0; codes below 0x20 other than 8 are ignored (signed compare); codes >= 0x20 store the low byte then a NUL (one byte past the 256 byte buffer when the source holds 255 bytes).

Headless Ghidra listing of 00481fe0; strlen of the receiver String text via 0042ab50. Re-read independently: FUN_0045d910 yields the receiver payload, 0042ab50 returns its int field 0 (global 0062e008 is only ever written 0, at 0040ff60), then SCASB.REPNE counts bytes up to the NUL.

Headless Ghidra listing of 00481cf0 and strtok 00554c70 (delimiter bitmap including NUL, position saved in the caller); null result interned as 0 by 004174a0. Re-read independently: the copy keeps the NUL (stack buffer up to 256 bytes, heap above), strtok 00554c70 skips leading delimiters, a delimiter bitmap always includes NUL and the next position is saved by the caller; the loop returns token number index, null for a negative index (loops until strtok returns 0) or one past the last token.
Headless Ghidra listing of 0047be60: argument parser call and return only. Re-read independently: body is FUN_0045d910(this, 0, &arg) then return, so only the String argument is parsed.
